title: oldenlandia stipulata
intro: Oldenlandia stipulata, commonly known as Asian teacushion or small-flowered oldenlandia, is a plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae. It is a herb used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, for its therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Oldenlandia stipulata include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which may help in reducing oxidative stress, alleviating fever, and treating infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
